description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

description.zh: 地址的ID，地址唯一标识码。
description.en: The ID of the address. This ID uniquely identifies the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 传入的参数作为更新后的备注，传空值则删除备注。
description.en: The input parameter serves as the updated note; if an empty value is passed, the note will be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-remark --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --remark test --region cn-hangzhou
